anomalies.description: Multiple individuals in yellow jumpsuits engage in physical combat: one person is seen grabbing and throwing another over a table, while others grapple and strike nearby.

A large group of individuals in yellow hazmat suits and others in dark tactical gear are engaged in chaotic, violent movement within a multi-level industrial facility; some individuals are seen raising arms, lunging, and clashing, indicating collective violent unrest.

Widespread violent unrest erupts in the cafeteria: groups of inmates in yellow uniforms are actively fighting, overturning tables, and moving chaotically; the scene shows collective violent disorder beyond isolated fights.

Multiple figures in dark tactical gear are visibly holding firearms and aiming them toward the central figure and other yellow-suited individuals; muzzle flashes or weapon discharge are not directly visible, but sustained aiming posture and context strongly indicate active shooting during the riot.
